thread:
lee: Zephyr gave tentative EAP ship date for hardware (next Tue) and want to run our microbench. Need NDA sign + lab window. Can someone own check-in?
marta: I can own the logistics. Ops window: Tue/Thu receive only, Telco preferred. Will need serial list and whether partner wants our image preloaded.
tom: Bench owner here. We prefer synthetic prompts and a soak plan to catch thermal. Suggested plan: 2 cold runs, 1 warm run, 1x 30m soak. Collect gpu_temp, gpu_power, freq.
claire: Legal: NDA redline incoming. Partner asked for a 7-business-day mutual embargo instead of full restriction. We can accept mutual embargo with explicit publish approval.
ops-bot: NOTE: lab_accept_window=Tue/Thu, max_package_weight=30kg, COURIER=DHL. Please attach chain-of-custody form.
sam-zephyr: We'll upload NDA redline here: https://zephyr-files.s3/nda_v3.pdf. We'll attach test image after NDA. Default stress config: --threads=48 --seq=4096. Also confirm carrier and lab windows.
marta: DHL ok. I'll schedule pickup Mon evening for Tue arrival. Please send serials and OS build notes.
tom: Example run command (will live in bench repo):
```
./zephyr_bench.sh \\
  --model redwood/fast-7b \\
  --seq 4096 \\
  --batch 1 \\
  --quant int8 \\
  --threads 48 \\
  --collect gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq \\
  --soak 1800
```
claire: Legal will send mutual embargo clause. We'll require aggregated metrics only and no raw logs with prompts.
